notes: Portable Annex C.3 object-attribute composition uses only official IEEE 1516.1-2025 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador interfaces with adapter-owned FOM modules. It checks the positive disjoint attribute-set union through both handle lookups, rejects conflicting semantics for one same-named attribute as InconsistentFOM, and checks a valid federation-name retry. Native official-API and installed-package results are recorded in the roadmap handoff. Java compiled against the API-only JAR and focused packaged-provider runtime passed in both callback models (out/java-tck/object-attribute-merge-conflict-*-20261021.json). Interoperability and other attribute sub-elements are not claimed.
